videos.title: Why an Octopus Has Blue Blood and 3 Hearts
videos.description: Octopuses have three hearts and copper-rich blue blood that helps them survive in cold waters. When they swim, their main heart actually takes a break! #shorts #oceanlife #wildlife #sciencefacts

videos.title: How Much Does a Fluffy Cloud Actually Weigh?
videos.description: You might think clouds are light as a feather, but an average cumulus cloud weighs as much as one hundred elephants! Learn how tons of water droplets stay afloat in the sky. #shorts #science #clouds #nature #facts

videos.title: Lightning Is 5 Times Hotter Than the Sun
videos.description: A single bolt of lightning can reach thirty thousand degrees Celsius, making it five times hotter than the surface of the Sun. That extreme heat causes the air to violently expand into a sonic boom of thunder! #shorts #science #weather #nature #space

videos.title: Your Body Makes 2 Million New Blood Cells Every Second
videos.description: Your bone marrow works around the clock to create millions of new red blood cells every second. Discover how your body keeps oxygen flowing continuously! #shorts #humanbody #science #biology #facts

videos.title: The Sun Holds 99.8 Percent of All Solar System Mass
videos.description: The Sun dominates our solar system by holding nearly all of its total mass. Discover how small all the planets are in comparison! #space #astronomy #science #facts #shorts
sources: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum

videos.title: The T-Rex lived closer to us than to Stegosaurus
videos.description: The timeline of the dinosaurs is much longer than you think! Learn why some famous species never actually met. #shorts #dinosaurs #science #history

videos.title: Sharks are older than trees
videos.description: Sharks have been swimming in our oceans for hundreds of millions of years, predating trees and even Saturn's rings! Discover how these ancient survivors conquered time. #shorts #nature #sharks #science #ocean

videos.title: Your stomach acid can dissolve metal
videos.description: The human body is full of surprises! Learn how your stomach handles acid strong enough to dissolve some metals. #shorts #science #biology

videos.title: Why do babies have more bones than adults
videos.description: Humans start life with around 300 bones but end up with only 206. Discover how your skeleton fuses together as you grow! #shorts #humanbody #science #biology #skeleton
